watch_outs: The units are the authors' spike sorting of this one run epoch; the raw recording is DANDI 001942, which does not hold this sorting (the Zenodo record), so these units cannot be matched to another epoch's.

No headings: the file's head_orientation (from the front and back LEDs) minus the direction of movement above 10 cm/s has a circular mean of +13.1 degrees (median spread 20.4 degrees): the head's direction with a constant offset, from the LEDs' mounting or the rat's head posture, which the file cannot tell apart. It is kept in params['head_orientation'] (radians, [-π, π]); subtract the offset only if it is the mounting.

63.8% of tracked head samples lie farther than half the 6.5 cm hallway width from the track graph: 79.3% of stopped (below 10 cm/s) samples and 43.6% of moving samples. This is tracking spread, not misfit: the head-mounted LEDs swing past the hallways' walls (3 cm high, the Methods of Comrie et al.'s preprint, bioRxiv 2024.09.23.613567) and a raised head projects outward, while each edge's samples are centred on it (see the environment's conversions). The positions are kept as stored.

Positions are the authors' smoothed, interpolated head positions, upsampled to 500 Hz from a 30 frames/s camera (the Methods of Comrie et al.'s preprint, bioRxiv 2024.09.23.613567), about 16 samples per video frame, so speeds and held-sample counts are those of smoothed, interpolated positions, not of raw tracking.

944 runs of 11 or more identical position samples (10 or more repeats of the sample before; 16879 repeats, 2.38% of samples, 33.8 s in all, the longest 0.2 s). Positions are kept as stored. A held run is lost tracking if the tracker repeated its last fix, or the animal holding still; check before analysing stops (wells, ripples). No speed limit is stated for this dataset, so fast steps are not counted.

7094 tracked position samples of 709321 (1.00%) lie outside the declared environment (env.bin_at gives -1): about 1% by construction, since the track's width was set from these samples' 99% quantile distance from the track, so the share measures neither the tracking nor the fit; 1.1% of stopped (below 10 cm/s) samples and 0.8% of moving samples are outside. They are kept as stored and fall in no bin.
21 of 203 units have no spikes in the analysed epochs (the tracked span); they are kept, as the file lists them, and are units['fires_in_epochs'] False.

behavior.laps.note:
InputError: detect_laps(method='auto') counts laps around a loop, but this environment has no loop: its track graph has no cycle, or its area has no hole to run around.
Why: on a track, a tree maze or in an open arena the animal can always come back the way it went, so no lap goes round a loop and the laps found would have direction 'unknown'.
Fix: for back-and-forth runs on a linear track or arm, use detect_trials(env, times, positions, regions=[start, end]); to segment round trips against a template, pass method='reference' with reference_lap=, which reports each round trip's direction along the track as 'increasing' or 'decreasing'.

hazards.message:
All 203 units are silent from 1625935757.7 s to 1625937176.3 s (1419 s) while position is tracked. If the electrophysiology was not recording then, pass spike_window=(start, stop) so that time is excluded from occupancy.
870018/870018 spike_times (100%) across all neurons fell outside the position time window [1.62594e+09, 1.62594e+09]; spike_times.min()=1.62594e+12 spike_times.max()=1.62594e+12. The spike times span 1.41864e+06 and reach 1.62594e+12, about 1000 times the 1418.64 s of times: if spike_times are in milliseconds, divide them by 1000. Check that spike_times and times share units (both seconds). Dropped spikes do not contribute. Set warn_on_drop=False to suppress this warning.

bin_size=4.0 is at least the per-axis data extent [2.026, 1.896] in every dimension.
Why: this produces very few bins, and it is often a units mistake: positions in m but bin_size meant in cm, for example.
Fix: check that bin_size and positions use the same units, then use a bin_size well below the data extent, such as bin_size=0.04

InputError: Interval filtering excluded ALL trajectory intervals (active gate(s) max_gap=1.0, min_speed=10.0).
Why: no sampling interval is left to analyse; rather than return a result in which occupancy is zero in every bin, the call refuses.
Fix: check that min_speed=10.0 is in the positions' length units per second.

InputError: Interval filtering excluded ALL trajectory intervals (active gate(s) max_gap=1.0, min_speed=10.0).
Why: no sampling interval is left to analyse; rather than return a result in which the rate map is empty, the call refuses.
